waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Here are some great ways to spend your weekend in Tesoro Highlands.

🎃 *Sat 9 AM* — Gilchrist Farm Harvest Festival & Pumpkin Patch (free)
   Pumpkins, farm fun, free entry for all ages.
🎸 *Fri 4 PM* — Loud @ the Library: Powered by Music Lab 🎸 (free)
   Live music for kids and teens at the library.
🎢 *Fri 6:30 PM* — Fright Fest at Six Flags Magic Mountain
   Evening thrills for the whole family at Magic Mountain.
🌽 *Sun 8:30 AM* — Valencia FivePoint Farmers Market (free)
   Local farmers market to start Sunday morning.
☕ *Fri 11 AM* — The Breakfast Club - Molletes (free)
   Adults gather for food and conversation.

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
